Thank you San Antonio Young Republicans! @YRSanAntonio 

“The San Antonio Young Republicans are proud to officially endorse Chip Roy for Attorney General of Texas! 

Texas needs a fighter in Austin who doesn’t just talk about the Constitution - he defends it. From his time as First Assistant AG to his bold leadership in Congress, Chip has proven he has the backbone to stand up to federal overreach and secure our borders.

Why we’re backing Chip:
✅ Proven Experience: He knows the AG office better

Denaturalization is absolutely a tool we should use, often. Our system has been abused by fraudsters, criminals, and those who lied to obtain status.

Citizenship is a privilege grounded in allegiance to the USA and the rule of law not a shield for people who exploited the system

Video

Crazy storms in Central Texas. 

Everyone be safe.

Due to popular demand across the state, we put the “Don’t Mecca My Texas” bumper stickers online! 

Grab yours today and join the grassroots movement to keep Texas FREE. 

secure.winred.com/texans-for…

TX AG is not an entry-level position. It is the most important legal job in America outside the US AG.

You must be ready to lead ~4000 employees, manage litigation, and defend TX in state and federal court. My opponent has no documented courtroom experience.

Video

Great conversation with liberty champion @NickJFreitas on my legal background, redistricting battles, federalism, 
 and why Texas needs an Attorney General ready for battle on Day One.

Thanks for having me on.

Full interview: piped.video/watch?v=9sIRzy…

Video

Happy Mother’s Day to my mom, who has stood by me through every chapter of life and some of the hardest battles, including cancer.

And to the mother of my children, thank you for your strength, love, and grace through it all.

Today we honor the women who hold families together and love without condition.

God bless all the moms out there
